en.summary: Mövenpick MS Darakum combines Moroccan-inspired interiors, 52 cabins and suites, and Mövenpick hospitality with a journey through Egypt’s history and Nile landscapes. Warm colours and decorative details give the ship a distinctive setting for sightseeing and time on the river.
en.description:
Mövenpick MS Darakum combines Moroccan-inspired interiors, 52 cabins and suites, and Mövenpick hospitality with a journey through Egypt’s history and Nile landscapes. Warm colours and decorative details give the ship a distinctive setting for sightseeing and time on the river.

Alongside short cruises between Luxor and Aswan, Darakum offers extended voyages between Cairo and Aswan. These longer journeys reach Middle Egypt, including Beni Hassan, Tell el-Amarna, Abydos and Dendera—destinations beyond the usual short Nile cruise route.

Guests can relax by the outdoor pool, on the sun deck, or in the lounge between excursions. A main restaurant, lounge bar, fitness facilities and cultural entertainment complement the accommodation. Routes and operating seasons depend on the published sailing schedule, river conditions and navigation requirements; not every programme runs throughout the year.

Service charge and VAT

Two airport transfers, at the start and end of your cruise (Luxor or Aswan)

en.description:
Mövenpick MS Hamees combines contemporary interiors, comfortable cabins and spacious public areas with journeys between Luxor and Aswan. Upper-deck accommodation has larger Nile-facing windows, while lower-deck Classic Cabins use fixed portholes.

Three-, four- and seven-night programmes explore Luxor, Edfu, Kom Ombo and Aswan. Between excursions, guests can relax at the outdoor pool or sun deck, dine on Egyptian and international dishes, or spend time in the lounge bar, reading room and games area.

The ship offers six accommodation categories, from Classic Cabins to Executive Suites with separate seating areas and two bathrooms. It suits couples, families, history enthusiasts and small groups looking for a balance of cultural visits and time aboard. Family occupancy and child policies depend on the confirmed cabin and rate.

en.summary: Mövenpick MS Prince Abbas is a five-star deluxe Lake Nasser cruise ship sailing between Aswan and Abu Simbel. Its peaceful setting combines panoramic lake views, remote desert landscapes and archaeological discoveries in ancient Nubia.
en.description:
Mövenpick MS Prince Abbas is a five-star deluxe Lake Nasser cruise ship sailing between Aswan and Abu Simbel. Its peaceful setting combines panoramic lake views, remote desert landscapes and archaeological discoveries in ancient Nubia.

Three- and four-night journeys explore Kalabsha, Wadi El Seboua, Amada, the Temple of Derr, the Tomb of Pennut and the magnificent Abu Simbel Temples. Many of these monuments were relocated during the UNESCO campaign to save Nubia’s heritage. Kasr Ibrim is viewed from the ship, without a landing excursion.

The vessel has 65 cabins and suites, elegant dining and lounges, a plunge pool connected to a whirlpool, a sun deck, gymnasium, library and billiards room. Its construction was developed under Lloyd’s Register supervision according to the supplied technical factsheet. This is a Lake Nasser voyage, separate from the classic Luxor–Aswan Nile route.

ja.description:
Mövenpick MS Prince Abbasは、アスワンとアブ・シンベルの間を運航する5つ星デラックスのナセル湖クルーズ船です。静かな環境の中で、湖の眺望、人里離れた砂漠の景観、古代ヌビアの考古遺跡をあわせて楽しめます。

3泊と4泊の旅では、カラブシャ、ワディ・エル・セブア、アマダ、デル神殿、ペンヌトの墓、そして壮大なアブ・シンベル神殿を巡ります。これらの遺跡の多くは、ヌビアの遺産を救うためのユネスコのキャンペーンで移築されました。カスル・イブリムは船上から眺め、上陸観光はありません。

船内には65室の客室とスイート、上品なダイニングとラウンジ、ジャグジーにつながるプランジプール、サンデッキ、ジム、図書室、ビリヤード室があります。提供されたテクニカルファクトシートによると、建造はロイド船級協会の監督のもとで進められました。こちらはナセル湖の航海で、定番のルクソール〜アスワン間のナイル川航路とは別のものです。
